title: AI-Powered Talent Matching Platform
summary: The Dubai Government Human Resources Department proposes an AI-powered talent-matching platform to connect job seekers with suitable roles and reduce hiring bias; no pilot is reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Director General Office of the Dubai Government Human Resources Department submitted the proposal, with Transcend Technologies L.L.C. as its partner. The proposed platform would use AI to connect job seekers with suitable roles and to reduce hiring bias. The submission is current as of June 2025. It lists no pilot or testbed and names model development and training as future work. No source reports a pilot or an employment outcome.
purpose: Match workers' skills with employment opportunities.

ratings.reason: The department intends the platform to give job seekers fairer access to work, and no source reports an employment outcome.
The department intends the platform to improve talent matching for employers, and no source reports a hiring result.
